content: Concerning interpreting the input-output behavior, previous work generally treats Seq2Seq models as black-boxes BIBREF13, BIBREF7. For example, alvarez2017causal measure the relevance between two input-output tokens by perturbing the input sequence. However, they do not exploit any intermediate information such as gradients, and the relevance score only resembles attention scores. Recently, Jain2019AttentionIN show that attention scores are in weak correlation with the feature importance. Starting from this observation, we exploit the intermediate gradients to better estimate word importance, which consistently outperforms its attention counterpart across model architectures and language pairs.
